name: Roon
author: kingscott
description: Shows what is playing on Roon, opens Roon from the album art, and moves playback between zones. Connects to your Roon Core as an extension; enable it once in Roon under Settings > Extensions.

barWidget.description: Roon now playing, open Roon from the album art, and switch zones

schema.label: Roon Core address
schema.description: IP address or hostname of the computer running Roon Server, such as 192.168.1.20.
